description: A large stone cathedral with a silver-grey dome on a colonnaded drum, seen from a rooftop over a city of brick houses with chimneys smoking. In the foreground, a man in a grey periwig and dark coat looks up at the dome, beside a workman in an apron pointing upward with a plumb line. Stormy clouds with shafts of light fill the sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border or text visible.
